meta.description: Evidence vocabulary: every fact a rule can test, with the question asked to the user and, for measured facts, the parameters it is derived from.

kinds.observation: Reported by an operator or technician (sight, sound, touch, smell, gauges).
kinds.measurement: Derived only from sensor or test measurements.
kinds.asset: Taken from the asset frame (asset register).

high_vibration.label: Excessive vibration
high_vibration.question: Is the machine vibrating more than normal (felt by hand, visible, or above the usual reading)?

vibration_severe.label: Vibration in ISO 10816-3 Zone D
vibration_severe.question: Is vibration in ISO 10816-3 Zone D (level that can cause damage)?

high_axial_vibration.label: High axial vibration
high_axial_vibration.question: Is axial vibration high (roughly half of radial or more)?

spec_1x_radial.label: Spectrum: high 1× radial
spec_1x_radial.question: Does the vibration spectrum show a dominant 1× running-speed peak in the radial direction (not axial)?

spec_2x_axial.label: Spectrum: 1×/2× with strong axial
spec_2x_axial.question: Does the spectrum show elevated 1× and 2× peaks with a strong axial component?

spec_bearing_freq.label: Spectrum: bearing defect frequencies
spec_bearing_freq.question: Does the spectrum show non-synchronous peaks at bearing defect frequencies (BPFO/BPFI/BSF/FTF)?

bearing_noise.label: Bearing rumbling/grinding noise
bearing_noise.question: Is there a rumbling, grinding or growling noise from a bearing housing?

bearing_overheating.label: Bearing running hot
bearing_overheating.question: Is a bearing housing abnormally hot?

bearing_temp_critical.label: Bearing temperature at trip level
bearing_temp_critical.question: Is the bearing temperature at or above the trip level?

recent_reassembly.label: Recently re-installed / re-coupled
recent_reassembly.question: Was the machine re-installed, re-coupled or realigned in the last ~30 days?

rotor_deposits.label: Deposits/erosion on rotating parts
rotor_deposits.question: Were deposits, erosion, or missing balance weights seen on the impeller/fan/rotor?

grease_degraded.label: Grease discoloured/contaminated
grease_degraded.question: Is the bearing grease dark, hardened, or contaminated?

relube_overdue.label: Bearing relubrication overdue
relube_overdue.question: Is bearing relubrication overdue according to the schedule?

pipe_strain.label: Pipe strain on casing
pipe_strain.question: Is suction/discharge piping unsupported or forcing the pump casing (pipe strain)?

crackling_noise.label: Crackling 'gravel' noise
crackling_noise.question: Is there a crackling noise, like gravel or marbles passing through the pump?

low_flow.label: Low delivered flow
low_flow.question: Is the delivered flow lower than required?

low_head.label: Low head / discharge pressure
low_head.question: Is the discharge pressure (head) lower than normal for this flow?

no_flow.label: No liquid delivered
no_flow.question: Is the pump delivering no liquid at all?

pressure_fluctuation.label: Fluctuating discharge pressure
pressure_fluctuation.question: Is the discharge pressure gauge fluctuating or surging?

seal_leakage.label: Seal leakage
seal_leakage.question: Is there visible leakage from the mechanical seal / stuffing box?

suction_strainer_blocked.label: Suction strainer blocked
suction_strainer_blocked.question: Is the suction strainer/filter blocked (high ΔP or visibly fouled)?

solids_in_fluid.label: Solids in pumped liquid
solids_in_fluid.question: Does the pumped liquid contain solids, fibres or abrasive particles?

fluid_temp_high.label: Liquid hotter than design
fluid_temp_high.question: Is the liquid temperature above design (closer to its boiling point)?

suction_level_low.label: Low suction level / restricted suction valve
suction_level_low.question: Is the suction tank/sump level low, or the suction valve partly closed?

dry_run_event.label: Recent dry-running
dry_run_event.question: Did the pump run dry recently?

seal_flush_problem.label: Seal flush/cooling not flowing
seal_flush_problem.question: Is the seal flush or cooling line blocked or not flowing?

impeller_long_service.label: Impeller beyond wear life
impeller_long_service.question: Has the impeller/wear-ring set been in service beyond its expected wear life?

low_power_draw.label: Motor current lower than normal
low_power_draw.question: Is the pump motor current much lower than normal?

hazardous_fluid.label: Hazardous (flammable/toxic) liquid
hazardous_fluid.question: Is the pumped liquid flammable or toxic?

motor_overheating.label: Motor overheating
motor_overheating.question: Is the motor running excessively hot or is a thermal alarm active?

winding_temp_critical.label: Winding at/above insulation-class limit
winding_temp_critical.question: Is winding temperature at or above the insulation-class limit?

burning_smell.label: Burning smell / smoke
burning_smell.question: Is there a burning-insulation smell or smoke from the motor?

hums_no_start.label: Hums but will not start
hums_no_start.question: Does the motor hum but fail to start or accelerate?

trips_overload.label: Overload relay/breaker trips
trips_overload.question: Does the overload relay or breaker trip?

slow_acceleration.label: Slow acceleration
slow_acceleration.question: Is acceleration slow / starting time longer than normal?

current_pulsation.label: Pulsating current
current_pulsation.question: Does the ammeter needle pulsate/beat rhythmically under load?

speed_low.label: Speed below nameplate
speed_low.question: Is running speed noticeably below nameplate speed?

voltage_unbalance.label: Supply voltage unbalance > 1 %
voltage_unbalance.question: Is the supply voltage unbalance above 1 % (NEMA MG 1 method)?

supply_voltage_low.label: Supply voltage below 90 % of rated
supply_voltage_low.question: Is the supply voltage below 90 % of rated?

phase_loss.label: One phase missing
phase_loss.question: Is one supply phase missing (blown fuse, open contactor pole, loose terminal)?

current_unbalance.label: Phase-current unbalance
current_unbalance.question: Are the three phase currents noticeably unequal (> 10 % deviation)?

motor_overloaded.label: Current above nameplate FLA
motor_overloaded.question: Is the motor current above nameplate full-load current?

rotor_sidebands.label: MCSA rotor-bar sidebands
rotor_sidebands.question: Does current-signature analysis show (1±2s)f sidebands above −45 dB?

frequent_starts.label: Frequent starts / duty exceeded
frequent_starts.question: Is the motor started very frequently or beyond its duty cycle?

load_jam.label: Driven load jammed / heavier than design
load_jam.question: Is the driven load jammed, binding, or heavier than design?

low_temp_difference.label: Process–air ΔT < 8.6 K
low_temp_difference.question: Is the process-to-air temperature difference below 8.6 K?

low_spindle_speed.label: Speed < 1380 rpm
low_spindle_speed.question: Is the rotational speed below 1380 rpm?

power_near_limit.label: Power within 5 % of a limit
power_near_limit.question: Is mechanical power within 5 % of the 3.5 kW or 9 kW limit?

overstrain.label: Wear × torque above variant limit
overstrain.question: Is tool wear × torque above the variant limit (11/12/13 kNm·min)?

overstrain_approaching.label: Wear × torque ≥ 90 % of limit
overstrain_approaching.question: Is tool wear × torque within 10 % of the variant limit?

tool_wear_critical.label: Tool wear ≥ 200 min
tool_wear_critical.question: Has the tool accumulated 200 min or more of cutting time?

poor_surface_finish.label: Deteriorating surface finish
poor_surface_finish.question: Is the machined surface finish deteriorating (burrs, chatter marks)?

cutting_noise_changed.label: Changed cutting noise / chatter
cutting_noise_changed.question: Has the cutting noise changed or is there chatter?

continuous_loading.label: Compressor loaded almost all the time
continuous_loading.question: Has the compressor been running loaded for most of the last 30 minutes?

high_motor_load.label: High average motor current
high_motor_load.question: Is the average motor current above 4.5 A (normal is about 2 A)?

oil_temp_high.label: Compressor oil running hot
oil_temp_high.question: Is the compressor oil temperature above 76 °C?

panel_pressure_low.label: Pneumatic panel pressure below cut-in
panel_pressure_low.question: Did the panel pressure fall below 8.2 bar?

dryer_purge_high.label: High dryer discharge pressure while loaded
dryer_purge_high.question: Is the dryer discharge (DV) pressure above 1 bar while the compressor is loaded?

low_pressure_alarm.label: Low-pressure alarm (LPS) active
low_pressure_alarm.question: Is the low-pressure alarm (below 7 bar) active?

hissing_heard.label: Air hissing heard
hissing_heard.question: Can you hear air hissing from the pneumatic system?

dryer_leak_observed.label: Air escaping at the dryer
dryer_leak_observed.question: Is air escaping at the dryer towers or their drain valve?
